translations.web: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.
translations.bsb: And not only did they do as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, through the will of God.
translations.kjv: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
